RecorderPrincipal.name: X-Recorder-Principal-Signature
RecorderPrincipal.description: HMAC-SHA256 proof over X-Recorder-Principal-User, a NUL byte, and X-Recorder-Principal-Device. The deployment secret stays outside the API payload and logs.

DeviceId.name: device_id
DeviceId.description: Registered active device identity; a Phone may bridge-read a Watch-targeted artifact.

UserId.name: user_id
UserId.description: Owner identity paired with the registered active device.

ChunkUpload.description: Raw chunk bytes; X-Chunk-SHA256 may bind the expected digest.
